messages:
Ellen: Quick follow-up from today's all-hands 7: can leadership give a one-sentence framing we can use in customer conversations about Redwood's mission and why customers should pick Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private?
Raj: Short framings: Hosted = fastest path to build and iterate; Dedicated = committed capacity + predictable latency; Private = full control and compliance.
Priya: For customers asking about cloud provider endpoints: say that cloud endpoints are general-purpose infra. We tune the whole inference stack (kernels, KV caching, routing) to drive down per-token cost and stabilize latency.
Noah: Sales note: add a line about predictable billing and migration path (Hosted -> Dedicated -> Private). Helps reduce "lock-in" concerns.
Ellen: Nice. Can we get a 1-pager and a 1-slide cheat sheet for GTM? One-pager for technical buyers and a cheat sheet for quick field use.
Jamie: Marketing can draft both. Request: include two short customer anecdotes (one PLG startup that scaled to Dedicated, one enterprise that required Private) with numbers if possible.
Raj: Runtime will provide 3-4 bullets on optimizations we actually ship (e.g., continuous batching, KV prefix caching, quantization guidance, kernel selection). That helps technical buyers.
Priya: Also call out operational features: rollout policies, tracing, token-level cost visibility. Those are big differentiators for platform teams.
Noah: On competitors: don't position as "we're cheaper" 7: instead, highlight choice + observability + guardrails to keep models predictable in production.
Ellen: Action items: (1) Marketing to draft 1-pager + cheat sheet (Jamie), (2) Runtime to supply short tech bullets (Raj), (3) Sales to collect quick anecdote + numbers (Noah). Can we review drafts by EOW?
Jamie: Yep, will get first drafts by Thursday. marketing-bot: Reminder set for 2026-04-09 to review drafts. :calendar:
